entities.summary: Carla Rebecchi is an Argentine field hockey player who won the bronze medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing and the silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London with the Argentina national field hockey team. In 2010, she won the World Cup in Rosario, Argentina. Carla has also won six Champions Trophy tournaments, the 2014–2015 World League, three medals at the Pan American Games and two Pan American Cups.
